title: Forested Mountain Along River Valley, 1920s Sepia Landscape Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage snapshot capturing a tranquil landscape featuring a wide, calm body of water flowing past a steep, densely wooded hillside. The foliage along the bank shows a mix of dense evergreens and deciduous trees descending straight down to the rocky shoreline, while an overexposed white sky frames the summit. Typical of 1910s to 1920s amateur roll-film cameras such as the No. 1A or No. 2A Kodak, which utilized elongated negative formats popular for travel and nature scenery.
